# Smart Padhai

> Smart Padhai is a free AI study planner for Indian Class 11–12 science students preparing for JEE Main 2027 and the RBSE (Rajasthan Board, BSER Ajmer) Class 12 board exam 2027. It ranks every Physics, Chemistry and Maths chapter by priority using official RBSE 2026–27 chapter marks and JEE Main question weightage, and gives daily study plans, AI practice questions, AI notes, an AI doubt-solving assistant, NCERT chapter PDFs, spaced revision, streaks and analytics.

## Public pages
- [Syllabus hub](https://study-os-indol.vercel.app/syllabus): priority-wise syllabus for JEE Main and RBSE Class 12
- [RBSE Class 12 syllabus 2026-27 with chapter-wise marks](https://study-os-indol.vercel.app/syllabus/rbse-class-12)
- [JEE Main 2027 syllabus with chapter-wise weightage](https://study-os-indol.vercel.app/syllabus/jee-main)
- [Android app (APK)](https://study-os-indol.vercel.app/downloads/smart-padhai.apk)

## Key facts
- RBSE Class 12 theory papers: Physics 56, Chemistry 56 (+14 sessional, +30 practical), Mathematics 80 (+20 sessional).
- Highest RBSE marks: Integrals 12; Continuity & Differentiability, 3D Geometry, Probability 8 each; Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids 7; Ray Optics and Semiconductor Electronics 6 each.
- JEE Main Paper 1: 25 questions per subject (Physics, Chemistry, Maths), 4 marks each, 300 marks total. NTA does not publish chapter weightage; Smart Padhai uses 2024–2026 paper trends.
- Removed from the rationalised RBSE Class 12 Chemistry syllabus: Solid State, Surface Chemistry, Isolation of Elements, p-Block, Polymers, Chemistry in Everyday Life.

## Features
Priority-ranked syllabus · Today's Plan with chapter/topic picker · AI Planner (daily and full schedule to exam date) · AI Assistant (Hinglish supported) · AI practice MCQs with LaTeX formulas · AI notes · Pomodoro study timer · Spaced repetition revision · Weak-topic detection · PDF export · 6 themes · Android app.
